title: The Santa Summit
description: At a Santa-themed holiday event, three teachers get their groove back, strengthen their friendship and unexpectedly find love along the way.

title: Merry Christmas, Ted Cooper!
description: An unlucky weatherman hopes to share his Christmastime cheer with his high school crush.

title: A Fabled Holiday
description: Talia and her childhood best friend unexpectedly reunite in a curiously familiar-looking town that's full of Christmas spirit.

title: A Magical Christmas Village
description: A woman tells her young granddaughter, Chloe, that her miniature Christmas village can magically grant holiday wishes. As Chloe begins setting up the figurines, real-life events seem to mimic the scenes she creates.

title: A Blue Ridge Mountain Christmas
description: Hotel manager Willow returns to her stunning Virginia hometown to help her sister plan a Christmas wedding at the inn her family once owned.

title: Time for Him to Come Home for Christmas
description: Four days before Christmas, Elizabeth Athens receives a voicemail from a number she doesn't recognize. On the message, a man she doesn't know makes one final plea for the love of his life to give him a second chance.

title: Christmas Above the Clouds
description: Eager to avoid Christmas, Ella Neezer, a CEO, books an international trip that skips the holiday, until three spirits take Ella on a journey through her life to rediscover her Christmas spirit.

title: You, Me & the Christmas Trees
description: An arborist falls in love with a farmer as she tries to save his trees before the town tree lighting.

title: My Christmas Cowboy
description: Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, the pair reunite in the small Texas town of Fern where they must team up to save the town's Christmas Roundup.

title: The Nights Before Christmas
description: Marty gets caught in a time loop on Christmas Eve -- and he loves it. Then he meets down-on-her-luck Chloe, and for the first time since the loop started, he wants to see Christmas day.

title: A Season of Promises
description: Estranged sisters team up to get their father a date by Christmas to fulfill their late mother's final wish.

title: Pride, Prejudice and Mistletoe
description: When Darcy returns to her hometown for Christmas, and she reconnects with Luke, a former rival, they must plan a charity event together. As she spends time with her family and Luke, she starts to realize what matters most in life.

title: Christmas With the Darlings
description: When an assistant gives her final notice, she is drawn into helping the younger brother of her boss as he looks after his orphaned nieces and nephew through Christmas.

title: Sugarplummed
description: When Emily wishes for a perfect Christmas like the ones found in the popular Sugarplum movies, she's shocked when Sugarplum herself appears to help her fulfill it.

title: Oy to the World!
description: Old high school rivals must put aside their differences as they work together on a fundraising event for a damaged temple. In doing so, they soon discover that teamwork can move mountains and open hearts, including their own.

title: Merry & Bright
description: Merry and Bright Candy Cane Company owner Cate meets a man during the busy Christmas season and assumes he is the suitor her mother is trying to set her up with.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
description: Single dad Taylor is inspired more than ever to give his two children the best Christmas in their new town. He leads the city's holiday event department, as new colleague Sophie supervises him.

title: A Make or Break Holiday
description: A couple decide they need a break from each other as stress and unspoken irritations reach a boiling point. However, as they work together to create a memorable Christmas for their families, they soon rediscover what they love about each other.

title: The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
description: A snowbound stranger (Warren Christie) brightens the holidays for a retired police officer (Henry Winkler) and his niece (Brooke Burns).

title: Forgotten Holiday
description: After an accident leading to sudden memory loss, Kathryn must re-date her boyfriend of one year, Rob, in an effort to get his memories back and remind him of his love of Christmas.

title: The Nights Before Christmas
description: Marty gets caught in a time loop on Christmas Eve -- and he loves it. Then he meets down-on-her-luck Chloe, and for the first time since the loop started, he wants to see Christmas day.
